title: Decoding Dynamic Reciprocal Neural Mechanisms underlying Reactive Agression: Insights from fMRI and fNIRS Hyperscanning
summary: This project (A06) ist part of the main project Transregio 379 „Neuropsychobiology of Aggression: A transdiagnostic Approach in Mental disorders".  In this study we want to better understand the neurobiological underpinnings of reactive aggression (RA) in social interactions during adolescence. For this, we will measure the brain activities of interacting peers simultaneously, an approach known as hyperscanning, using fMRI or fNIRS, while they complete several tasks either in pairs (dyads) or in three-person groups (triads). In these tasks we will experimentally manipulate breaches of trust, provocation and social exclusion to examine the effects on reactive aggression. We will include both healthy adolescents without any psychiatric disorders as well as in/outpatients with different psychiatric diagnoses. All subjects will complete a battery of questionnaires as well as smartphone-based assessments in everyday life (see Q01) to link these measures (such as their RA levels or everyday social exclusion experiences) to hyperscanning brain measurements.
conditions: This study is transdiagnostic and will include several psychiatric disorders of axis I and II according to ICD-10. Excluded are developmental disorders, mental retardation and neurodegenerative disorders.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
• Clear understanding of the study information and personally and voluntarily signed consent form by the participants and their legal guardians.
• Good understanding of the German language.
• For patients: any mental disorder according to DSM-5/ ICD-10/ ICD-11.
Exclusion criteria:
• Severe mental retardation (IQ<50)
• Inability to comply with the study protocol.
• Participants with severe somatic or neurological disorders that affect the central nervous system.
• MRI contraindications will be further exclusion criteria (e.g. active implants, metal in body).
• For healthy controls: any mental disorder according to DSM-5/ ICD-10/ ICD-11
• Pregnancy
• other chronic or acute physical diseases
